title: 美联储说看数据：数据没出先引导耐心，卡巴纳为何问现在等什么？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Mark Abanna, a Bank of America with this to say, strong US data is likely to reinforce the high-code bond spike issue.
segments.zh: 美银的Mark Cabana表示，强劲的美国数据可能强化高收益债券的飙升问题。

segments.en: Fed patients feels politically driven to us.
segments.zh: 美联储的耐心在我们看来似乎带有政治驱动。

segments.en: Mark joins us now for more. Mark, good morning. Good morning.
segments.zh: Mark现在加入我们了解更多。Mark，早上好。早上好。

segments.en: It's a spicy last line. What do you mean by it? We are confused as well.
segments.zh: 最后一句很尖锐。你是什么意思？我们也感到困惑。

segments.en: I hear that from Mike. We hear it from investors. Investors don't understand why the Fed wants to wait now.
segments.zh: 我从Mike那里听到，也从市场参与者那里听到。市场参与者不理解为什么美联储现在想等待。

segments.en: We also don't understand why the Fed was guiding for a more patient posture ahead of the data.
segments.zh: 我们也不理解为什么美联储在数据发布前就引导更耐心的姿态。

segments.en: They say their data dependent, but they're guiding before the data comes. It's confusing to us why wait now.
segments.zh: 他们说依赖数据，但在数据出来前就引导。这让我们困惑，为什么现在要等待。

segments.en: Inflation looks like it's broadening, at least in CPI and PPI.
segments.zh: 通胀看起来在扩大，至少在CPI和PPI中是这样。

segments.en: It may be that diesel- elevated diesel prices are spilling over a little bit.
segments.zh: 可能是柴油价格高企带来了一些溢出效应。

segments.en: It may just be that we're seeing owners equivalent rent bottom.
segments.zh: 也可能只是业主等价租金触底了。

segments.en: But for whatever reason, inflation seems to be broadening, yet the Fed seems to be wanting to stay on hold and essentially instruct the market for a quarterly hiking cadence.
segments.zh: 但不知何故，通胀似乎在扩大，而美联储似乎想按兵不动，并实质上引导市场预期季度加息节奏。

segments.en: We don't fully understand why. I agree this is going to be chairworses job to explain.
segments.zh: 我们不完全理解原因。我同意这将是主席的工作来解释。

segments.en: And not having a good data explanation, we then have to speculate for other reasons.
segments.zh: 没有好的数据解释，我们只能推测其他原因。

segments.en: Is it politically driven? We don't know. They will never tell us that it is.
segments.zh: 是政治驱动吗？我们不知道。他们永远不会告诉我们。

segments.en: But having that preference for a quarterly cadence we're left wondering, are they concerned about underlying fragilities in the economy?
segments.zh: 但对季度节奏的偏好让我们不禁想问，他们是否担心经济中的潜在脆弱性？

segments.en: Perhaps they should let us know. But that type of explanation, I think, is what the market is wanting.
segments.zh: 也许他们应该让我们知道。但我认为，市场想要的正是这种解释。
